# OWASP coverage

<!-- GENERATED by `counsel compliance` from compliance/owasp.yaml. Do not edit. -->

What Counsel does about each risk, the tests that show it, and what remains. Reviewed 2026-11-08 by platform. CI regenerates this page and fails if a row cites a test or file that does not exist, and runs every cited test.

**7 full, 9 partial, 2 not applicable** across 18 risks. Partial means the gap is named in the last column, not hidden.

## [OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026](https://genai.owasp.org/resource/owasp-top-10-for-agentic-applications-for-2026)

| Risk | Coverage | How Counsel handles it | Evidence | What remains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ASI01** Agent Goal Hijack | Partial | Contained, not prevented. An injected ticket, issue or update can steer what an agent writes, but not past its Postgres role: no commitment, secret, customer thread or audit edit is reachable. Drafts that offer an action are flagged for the reviewer, and a person publishes every draft. The bench replays real hijacks and twenty injected goals with a model scripted to obey the attacker: the broad control bot is harmed by every one, Counsel by none. | [`test_no_agent_can_read_or_touch_secrets`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_a_draft_offering_an_action_is_flagged_for_the_reviewer`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_the_simulated_model_obeys_an_injected_ticket`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_cost.py)<br>[`test_the_injection_suite_has_twenty_goals_each_written_down`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_bench.py)<br>[`bench/expected.json`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/bench/expected.json) | No classifier on incoming text. Injected text can still shape an allowed draft or nudge; the person reviewing it is the last check. |
| **ASI02** Tool Misuse & Exploitation | Full | The model never writes SQL. Tool calls are typed operations, and Postgres decides whether the agent's role may do them, so there is no allow-list in code to get wrong. The GitHub connector cannot assign, close or label. | [`test_tool_calls_cannot_carry_sql`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_tool_layer_has_no_allow_list_postgres_decides`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_the_connector_has_no_way_to_assign_close_or_label`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_platform.py) | An agent can still overuse what it is allowed: a nudge within its budget, a draft a person then publishes. |
| **ASI03** Identity & Privilege Abuse | Partial | Each agent is a Postgres role compiled from the registry. `counsel audit` reads the live privilege matrix on every push and fails on a commitment grant, a security definer backdoor, an unregistered role, or a runtime login that reaches another pool's agent. The agent that reads customer tickets runs on its own login and service. | [`test_no_role_can_write_a_commitment`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py)<br>[`test_audit_catches_security_definer_backdoor`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py)<br>[`test_each_runtime_login_reaches_only_its_own_pools_agents`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_red_team.py)<br>[`test_a_token_bound_to_another_server_is_refused_even_when_lenient`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_mcp_hosted.py) | The support pool's login still chooses which ticket the drafter sees (docs/red-team.md, R3). Strict MCP audience checks wait on Supabase Auth binding the audience (supabase/auth#2610). |
| **ASI04** Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities | Partial | Every GitHub Action is pinned by commit, workflows are audited by zizmor, Python dependencies by pip-audit and Dependabot, history by gitleaks, infrastructure by checkov, and the whole repository by OpenSSF Scorecard. Every deployed image carries signed build provenance and an SPDX SBOM. Counsel loads no third-party MCP servers or agent tools. Models are named explicitly and every call records which one answered. | [`.github/workflows/security.yml`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml)<br>[`.github/workflows/scorecard.yml`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/.github/workflows/scorecard.yml)<br>[`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml)<br>[`.github/dependabot.yml`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml)<br>[`test_success_records_model_and_usage`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_model.py) | Model weights are a hosted API, so their provenance is the provider's. The Python package is not published or signed; only the deployed image is attested. |
| **ASI05** Unexpected Code Execution | Full | No agent runs code. Model output is parsed as a typed tool call or kept as text; nothing is evaluated, and an unknown tool is returned to the model, not executed. | [`test_tool_calls_cannot_carry_sql`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_unknown_table_is_returned_to_the_model_not_raised`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py) | None known. |
| **ASI06** Memory & Context Poisoning | Partial | Agents cannot write the handbook they retrieve from. Answers must cite it, and the evals fail a missing or invented citation. Cached answers are keyed by the whole prompt, handbook text included, so an edited document is never served stale. | [`test_a_missing_or_invented_citation_fails`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_eval.py)<br>[`test_an_edited_document_is_a_new_request`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_cost.py) | Anyone who can edit the handbook can poison it; documents are not scanned. |
| **ASI07** Insecure Inter-Agent Communication | Not applicable | Agents never message each other. Work reaches an agent only as a job row a database trigger or schedule creates. | [`db/migrations/0003_runtime.sql`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/db/migrations/0003_runtime.sql) | Would apply if agents were given a way to call one another. |
| **ASI08** Cascading Failures | Partial | Each step is fenced to its lease, so a late worker cannot write over a newer one. Model calls have a time budget, failed jobs back off and dead-letter, a dead run takes back what it wrote, Postgres caps how often each person is messaged, and a billing guard cuts spend off. | [`test_after_a_takeover_only_the_new_holder_writes_and_closes_the_run`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_red_team.py)<br>[`test_one_call_cannot_outlast_its_budget_whatever_the_retries`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_red_team.py)<br>[`test_failures_back_off_then_dead_letter_with_an_audit_record`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_runtime.py)<br>[`test_a_dead_run_takes_back_what_it_wrote_atomically`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_platform.py)<br>[`test_postgres_refuses_a_message_over_the_budget`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_platform.py)<br>[`test_at_threshold_unlinks`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_billing_guard.py) | One region and one instance per pool; no breaker that pauses every agent when one provider degrades. |
| **ASI09** Human-Agent Trust Exploitation | Full | A person publishes every draft, on their own connection. A carried note needs a consent that hashes the exact text. An assistant's write is approved in the person's own browser against a hash of what they read; the assistant's own token, an old sign-in and changed text are refused by the database. | [`test_a_flagged_draft_cannot_be_published_unedited`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_ledger.py)<br>[`test_a_carry_whose_text_was_changed_after_consent_is_refused_and_audited`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_standup.py)<br>[`test_the_assistants_own_token_cannot_approve`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_proposals.py)<br>[`test_the_approval_covers_only_the_text_the_person_read`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_proposals.py) | A person can still approve something they did not read carefully. |
| **ASI10** Rogue Agents | Partial | A role exists only through the registry, and the audit fails on any other. The audit log is append-only, every refused write is recorded, and a whole run can be rolled back. drift_watcher raises platform problems as draft fixes. | [`test_audit_catches_unregistered_agent`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py)<br>[`test_audit_log_is_append_only`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py)<br>[`test_a_dead_letter_becomes_one_draft_fix_with_no_model`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_platform.py) | No anomaly detection on what agents write over time. |

## [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/)

| Risk | Coverage | How Counsel handles it | Evidence | What remains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **LLM01** Prompt Injection | Partial | Same as ASI01. Containment by role, not detection. | [`test_no_agent_can_post_to_the_customer_thread`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_the_injection_suite_has_twenty_goals_each_written_down`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_bench.py)<br>[`test_the_simulated_model_obeys_an_injected_ticket`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_cost.py) | No classifier; injected text can shape an allowed draft. |
| **LLM02** Sensitive Information Disclosure | Partial | Integration tokens are unreachable by every agent role. The drafter sees only the ticket its job is for. The dashboard login reads cost views only, never prompts. | [`test_drafter_sees_only_the_ticket_it_was_started_for`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_support.py)<br>[`test_the_reader_sees_no_prompt_ticket_task_or_secret_and_writes_nothing`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_cost.py) | Prompts and responses are journaled in full for replay, so the journal holds ticket text; access to it is limited to the orchestrator, the MCP login and owners. |
| **LLM06** Excessive Agency | Full | The founding rule: no agent can set an owner, a due date or a status, and a trigger refuses it even after a mistaken grant. CI fails if any role could. | [`test_no_role_can_write_a_commitment`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py)<br>[`test_mistaken_update_grant_is_caught_by_trigger_and_audit`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_commitments.py) | None known for commitments; drafts and nudges are agency a person reviews. |
| **LLM10** Unbounded Consumption | Full | Each call has a time budget, questions are rate-limited, owners get a projected overrun, and the billing guard unlinks billing past the budget. | [`test_one_call_cannot_outlast_its_budget_whatever_the_retries`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_red_team.py)<br>[`test_a_projected_overrun_is_flagged_to_the_owner`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_cost.py)<br>[`test_at_threshold_unlinks`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_billing_guard.py) | None known. |

## [MCP Security Best Practices (2025-11-25)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/security_best_practices)

| Risk | Coverage | How Counsel handles it | Evidence | What remains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **MCP-TOKEN-PASSTHROUGH** Token passthrough | Full | The server uses the access token only to learn who is calling. It never forwards it; the database is reached with the server's own narrow login. | [`test_the_mcp_login_still_cannot_read_tasks_or_links_directly`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_mcp_hosted.py) | None known. |
| **MCP-AUDIENCE** Tokens issued for another server | Partial | A token bound to a different resource is refused, and every call logs whether its audience was bound. Strict checking is ready behind a setting. | [`test_a_token_bound_to_another_server_is_refused_even_when_lenient`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_mcp_hosted.py)<br>[`test_strict_mode_refuses_an_unbound_token`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_mcp_hosted.py) | Supabase Auth gives every token aud "authenticated" (supabase/auth#2610), so strict mode stays off until it binds the audience. |
| **MCP-CONSENT** Consent for what a client does (confused deputy) | Full | Connecting consents to a client; each write also needs the person's approval of the exact text, sent by URL-mode elicitation where the client supports it, and checked by the database. | [`test_a_client_that_supports_url_elicitation_is_sent_to_the_approval_page`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_proposals.py)<br>[`test_the_approval_link_is_not_signed_in`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_proposals.py)<br>[`test_the_mcp_login_cannot_reach_the_approval_at_all`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/tests/test_proposals.py) | None known. |
| **MCP-SESSION** Session hijacking | Not applicable | The hosted server is stateless: every request carries its own token and nothing is kept between requests, so there is no session id to steal. | [`src/counsel/mcp_server.py`](https://github.com/shanurwan/counsel/blob/main/src/counsel/mcp_server.py) | Would apply if the server kept sessions. |
